Fun,Ⓒs.Ⓓpari(rI)hAsaH, narman n., krIqA, KelA, keli f., prahasanaM, krIqAkOtukaM; ‘said in f(un)’ narmaBAzitaM, narmAlApaH.
ⓃFunny,Ⓒa.ⒹhAsajanaka, vinodanaSIla, rasika, kOtuka-kArin, narma-parihAsa- in comp.
Ⓑ
 2 upahAsya, aparUpa.

Function,Ⓒs.ⒹvyApAraH, karman n., kAryaM, kftyaM, cezwA, kriyA, cezwitaM, vyavasAyaH, vyavahAraH, vftti f., pravftti f.
Ⓑ
 2 niyogaH, aDikAraH, padaM.
Ⓑ
 3 AcaraRaM, anuzWAnaM, karaRaM.
Ⓑ
 4 guRaH, DarmaH, svaBAvaH.
Ⓑ
 5 iMdriyaM, Sakti f., karmeMdriyaM.
Ⓝ[Function]ary,Ⓒs.Ⓓniyogin m., aDikArin m. kAryanirvAhakaH, niyuktaH, aDikftaH.

Fund,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMcayaH, puMjaH, rASiH, samudAyaH, nicayaH, saMyogaH, saMnipAtaH; See Collection.
Ⓑ
 2 mUlaDanaM, nIvi-vI f.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹsaM-ci 5 U, saMgrah 9 P, puMjIkf 8 U, rASIkf.

Fundament,Ⓒs.ⒹgudaM, mAyuH, apAnaM, maladvAraM.
Ⓑ
 2 aDoBAgaH, talaM.

Fundamental,Ⓒa.ⒹpraDAna, sAra, sAraBUta, gurvarTa, mOlika, mUla in comp.; ‘f(undamental) cause’ mUlakAraRaM; ‘f(undamental) principle’ mUlatatvaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹpraDAna-mUla-tatvaM, mUlaM, tattvaM, sAraH.

Funeral,Ⓒs.ⒹOrDvadehikakriyA, aMtyezwi f., pretakAryaM-kftyaM, pretanirhAraH, aMtyakriyA, uttara-kriyA-karman n., OrDvadehikaM, SrAdDAdi karma.
Ⓔa.ⒹOrDvadehika, OrDvadEhika (kI f.), better by (s.); ‘f(uneral) pile’ citA, citi-tI f., cityA.
Fungus,Ⓒs.ⒹviqjaM, gomayajaM, SilIDraM, SA-(sA)leyaH, SItaSivaH, CatrA, maDurikA, misi-Si-sI-SI- f., miSreyA.
